                        <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Lokasi Penyimpanan</label>
                        <select id="invLokasi" required class="mt-1 block w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-magenta-500 focus:border-magenta-500 sm:text-sm"></select>
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Stok</label>
                            <input type="number" id="invStok" required min="0" class="mt-1 block w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-magenta-500 focus:border-magenta-500 sm:text-sm">
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Min. Stok</label>
                            <input type="number" id="invStokMin" required min="0" class="mt-1 block w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-magenta-500 focus:border-magenta-500 sm:text-sm">
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Kondisi</label>
                        <select id="invKondisi" required class="mt-1 block w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-magenta-500 focus:border-magenta-500 sm:text-sm">
                            <option value="Baik">Baik</option>
                            <option value="Rusak Ringan">Rusak Ringan</option>
                            <option value="Rusak Berat">Rusak Berat</option>
                            <option value="Hilang">Hilang</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Tahun Perolehan</label>
                        <input type="number" id="invTahun" min="1990" max="2100" class="mt-1 block w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-magenta-500 focus:border-magenta-500 sm:text-sm">
                    </div>
                    <div class="md:col-span-2">
                        <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Keterangan</label>
                        <textarea id="invKeterangan" rows="2" class="mt-1 block w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-magenta-500 focus:border-magenta-500 sm:text-sm"></textarea>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="pt-4 border-t border-gray-200 flex justify-end space-x-3">
                    <button type="button" class="close-modal bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-4 inline-flex justify-center text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none">Batal</button>
                    <button type="submit" class="bg-magenta-600 border border-transparent rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-4 inline-flex justify-center text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-magenta-700 focus:outline-none">Simpan</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Modal Peminjaman (Buat Baru) -->
    <div id="modalPinjam" class="fixed inset-0 bg-gray-500 bg-opacity-75 flex items-center justify-center z-50 hidden-safely p-4">

            </div>
            <div class="p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1">
                <form id="formPinjam" class="space-y-4" onsubmit="return false;">
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">

                    <div class="mt-6 border-t pt-4">

                                    <!-- Dynamic rows -->
                                </tbody>
                            </table>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </form>
            </div>
            <div class="px-6 py-4 border-t border-gray-200 flex justify-end space-x-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-b-lg">
                <button type="button" class="close-modal bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-4 inline-flex justify-center text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50">Batal</button>
                <button type="button" id="btnSavePinjam" class="bg-magenta-600 border border-transparent rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-4 inline-flex justify-center text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-magenta-700">Simpan Transaksi</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Modal Pengembalian -->
    <div id="modalKembali" class="fixed inset-0 bg-gray-500 bg-opacity-75 flex items-center justify-center z-50 hidden-safely p-4">
        <div class="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl max-w-4xl w-full max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col">
            <div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-200 flex justify-between items-center bg-gray-50 rounded-t-lg">
                <h3 class="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900">Proses Pengembalian</h3>
                <button type="button" class="close-modal text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-500"><i class="fas fa-times text-xl"></i></button>
            </div>
            <div class="p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1" id="kembaliContent">
                <!-- Content generated by JS -->
            </div>
            <div class="px-6 py-4 border-t border-gray-200 flex justify-end space-x-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-b-lg role-admin-only">
                <button type="button" class="close-modal bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-4 inline-flex justify-center text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50">Tutup</button>
                <button type="button" id="btnProsesKembali" class="bg-emerald-600 border border-transparent rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-4 inline-flex justify-center text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-emerald-700">Proses Pengembalian</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Application Script -->
    <script>
        (function() {
            'use strict';

            // --- RUNTIME TRUTH ---
            var runtimeMode = document.body.getAttribute('data-runtime-mode');
            var isProduction = runtimeMode === 'production';
            var isCanvasMode = !isProduction;

            // --- STATE ---
            var state = {
                token: null,
                user: null,
                activePage: 'dashboard',
                data: {
                    inventaris: [],
                    kategori: [],
                    lokasi: [],
                    peminjaman: []
                },
                isSyncing: false
            };

            // --- DOM ELEMENTS ---
            var els = {
                banner: document.getElementById('demoAccessBanner'),
                loginView: document.getElementById('loginView'),
                mainApp: document.getElementById('mainApp'),
                loginForm: document.getElementById('loginForm'),
                btnLogout: document.getElementById('btnLogout'),
                navLinks: document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link'),
                pages: document.querySelectorAll('.page-section'),
                pageTitle: document.getElementById('pageTitle'),
                uiUserName: document.getElementById('uiUserName'),
                uiUserRole: document.getElementById('uiUserRole'),
                roleBadgeHeader: document.getElementById('roleBadgeHeader'),
                loader: document.getElementById('fullPageLoader'),
                toast: document.getElementById('toastContainer')
            };

            // --- MOCK DATABASE (Canvas Only) ---
            var mockDB = {
                users: [
                    { username: 'admin', password: 'bismillah', role: 'Admin', nama: 'Admin Lab' },
                    { username: 'kepsek', password: 'bismillah', role: 'Kepala Sekolah', nama: 'Bpk. Kepala Sekolah' }
                ],
                inventaris: [
                    { ID_Inventaris: 'INV-001', Kode_Inventaris: 'AL-001', Nama_Barang: 'Mikroskop Cahaya', Jenis: 'Alat', Kategori: 'Alat Optik', Satuan: 'Unit', Stok: 5, Stok_Minimum: 2, Kondisi: 'Baik', Lokasi: 'Lemari A1', Tahun_Perolehan: 2020 },
                    { ID_Inventaris: 'INV-002', Kode_Inventaris: 'BH-001', Nama_Barang: 'Alkohol 70%', Jenis: 'Bahan', Kategori: 'Cairan Kimia', Satuan: 'Botol', Stok: 1, Stok_Minimum: 3, Kondisi: 'Baik', Lokasi: 'Lemari Bahan B', Tahun_Perolehan: 2023 }
                ],
                kategori: [ { Nama_Kategori: 'Alat Optik' }, { Nama_Kategori: 'Cairan Kimia' }, { Nama_Kategori: 'Peralatan Gelas' } ],
                lokasi: [ { Nama_Lokasi: 'Lemari A1' }, { Nama_Lokasi: 'Lemari Bahan B' }, { Nama_Lokasi: 'Rak Tengah' } ],
                peminjaman: [
                    { ID_Peminjaman: 'TRX-001', Tanggal_Pinjam: '2026-08-20', Tanggal_Rencana_Kembali: '2026-08-25', Nama_Peminjam: 'Guru Biologi', Keperluan: 'Praktek Kelas 10', Status: 'Terlambat', details: [
                        { ID_Inventaris: 'INV-001', Jumlah_Pinjam: 2, Jumlah_Kembali: 0 }
                    ]}
                ]
            };

            // --- INIT ---
            function initializeRuntimeMode() {
                if (!els.banner) return;
                if (isCanvasMode) {
                    els.banner.hidden = false;
                    return;
                }
                els.banner.hidden = true;
                els.banner.remove();
            }

            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
                initializeRuntimeMode();
                setupEventListeners();
                checkLoginState();
            });

            // --- UTILS ---
            function escapeHTML(str) {
                if (str === null || str === undefined) return '';
                var div = document.createElement('div');
                div.appendChild(document.createTextNode(str));
                return div.innerHTML;
            }

            function safeDate(dateStr) {
                if (!dateStr) return '-';
                var d = new Date(dateStr);
                return isNaN(d) ? '-' : d.toLocaleDateString('id-ID');
            }

            function showToast(msg, type = 'info') {
                var t = document.createElement('div');
                t.className = `toast ${type}`;
                t.textContent = msg;
                els.toast.appendChild(t);
                setTimeout(() => t.classList.add('show'), 10);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    t.classList.remove('show');
                    setTimeout(() => t.remove(), 300);
                }, 3000);
            }

            function showFullPageLoading(show, text = 'Memuat...') {
                if (show) {
                    document.getElementById('loaderText').textContent = text;
                    els.loader.classList.remove('hidden-safely');
                } else {
                    els.loader.classList.add('hidden-safely');
                }
            }

            // --- API COMMUNICATION ---
            function gasRun(functionName) {
                var args = Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments, 1);
                
                if (isCanvasMode) {
                    return runMock(functionName, args);
                }

                return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
                    if (!window.google || !google.script || !google.script.run) {
                        reject(new Error('Layanan Google Apps Script tidak tersedia.'));
                        return;
                    }
                    var runner = google.script.run
                        .withSuccessHandler(resolve)
                        .withFailureHandler(reject);
                    runner[functionName].apply(runner, args);
                });
            }

            function runMock(func, args) {
                return new Promise(function(resolve) {
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        var res = { success: false, message: 'Fungsi tidak ditemukan.' };
                        if (func === 'loginUser') {
                            var u = args[0], p = args[1];
                            var user = mockDB.users.find(x => x.username === u && x.password === p);
                            if (user) res = { success: true, token: 'mock-token-123', user: { username: user.username, role: user.role, nama: user.nama } };
                            else res = { success: false, message: 'Username/password salah.' };
                        } else if (func === 'validateSession') {
                            if (args[0] === 'mock-token-123') res = { success: true, user: mockDB.users[0] };
                            else res = { success: false, sessionExpired: true };
                        } else if (func === 'logoutUser') {
                            res = { success: true };
                        } else if (func === 'getDashboardData') {
                            res = { success: true, data: { total: 2, baik: 2, rusak_ringan: 0, rusak_berat: 0, hilang: 0, stok_rendah: 1, pinjam_aktif: 1, inv_list: mockDB.inventaris, stok_rendah_list: mockDB.inventaris.filter(i=>i.Stok<=i.Stok_Minimum) } };
                        } else if (func === 'getInventarisData') {
                            res = { success: true, inventaris: mockDB.inventaris, kategori: mockDB.kategori, lokasi: mockDB.lokasi };
                        } else if (func === 'saveInventaris') {
                            var item = args[1];
                            if(!item.ID_Inventaris) {
                                item.ID_Inventaris = 'INV-' + Date.now();
                                item.Kode_Inventaris = 'NEW-' + Date.now().toString().slice(-4);
                                mockDB.inventaris.push(item);
                            } else {
                                var idx = mockDB.inventaris.findIndex(i => i.ID_Inventaris === item.ID_Inventaris);
                                if(idx > -1) mockDB.inventaris[idx] = {...mockDB.inventaris[idx], ...item};
                            }
                            res = { success: true };
                        } else if (func === 'deleteInventaris') {
                            mockDB.inventaris = mockDB.inventaris.filter(i => i.ID_Inventaris !== args[1]);
                            res = { success: true };
                        } else if (func === 'getPeminjamanData') {
                            res = { success: true, peminjaman: mockDB.peminjaman, inventaris: mockDB.inventaris };
                        } else if (func === 'savePeminjaman') {
                            var header = args[1], details = args[2];
                            header.ID_Peminjaman = 'TRX-' + Date.now();
                            header.Status = 'Dipinjam';
                            header.details = details;
                            mockDB.peminjaman.push(header);
                            res = { success: true };
                        } else if (func === 'getReportData') {
                            res = { success: true, data: func==='peminjaman'?mockDB.peminjaman:mockDB.inventaris };
                        }
                        resolve(res);
                    }, 500); // simulate network delay
                });
            }

            // --- AUTHENTICATION ---
            function checkLoginState() {
                var storedToken = sessionStorage.getItem('lab_token');
                var storedUser = sessionStorage.getItem('lab_user');
                
                if (storedToken && storedUser) {
                    state.token = storedToken;
                    state.user = JSON.parse(storedUser);
                    showMainApp();
                    // Optional: Validate background
                } else {
                    showLoginView();
                }
            }

            async function handleLogin() {
                var u = document.getElementById('username').value.trim();
                var p = document.getElementById('password').value;
                if (!u || !p) return;

                showFullPageLoading(true, 'Verifikasi krendensial...');
                try {
                    var res = await gasRun('loginUser', u, p);
                    if (res.success) {
                        state.token = res.token;
                        state.user = res.user;
                        sessionStorage.setItem('lab_token', res.token);
                        sessionStorage.setItem('lab_user', JSON.stringify(res.user));
                        showToast('Login berhasil', 'success');
                        showMainApp();
                    } else {
                        showToast(res.message || 'Login gagal', 'error');
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    showToast('Terjadi kesalahan koneksi', 'error');
                } finally {
                    showFullPageLoading(false);
                }
            }

            function handleLogout() {
                if(!state.token) return;
                showFullPageLoading(true, 'Keluar...');
                gasRun('logoutUser', state.token).finally(() => {
                    sessionStorage.removeItem('lab_token');
                    sessionStorage.removeItem('lab_user');
                    state.token = null;
                    state.user = null;
                    state.data = { inventaris: [], kategori: [], lokasi: [], peminjaman: [] };
                    showLoginView();
                    showFullPageLoading(false);
                });
            }

            function handleSessionExpired() {
                sessionStorage.removeItem('lab_token');
                sessionStorage.removeItem('lab_user');
                showLoginView();
                showToast('Sesi berakhir. Silakan login kembali.', 'error');
            }

            function applyRoleRestrictions() {
                var isReadOnly = state.user && state.user.role === 'Kepala Sekolah';
                var elements = document.querySelectorAll('.role-admin-only');
                elements.forEach(el => {
                    if (isReadOnly) {
                        el.classList.add('role-hidden');
                    } else {
                        el.classList.remove('role-hidden');
                    }
                });
            }

            // --- NAVIGATION ---
            function showLoginView() {
                els.mainApp.classList.add('hidden-safely');
                els.loginView.classList.remove('hidden-safely');
                document.getElementById('loginForm').reset();
            }

            function showMainApp() {
                els.loginView.classList.add('hidden-safely');
                els.mainApp.classList.remove('hidden-safely');
                
                els.uiUserName.textContent = state.user.nama;
                els.uiUserRole.textContent = state.user.role;
                els.roleBadgeHeader.textContent = state.user.role;
                if(state.user.role === 'Admin') els.roleBadgeHeader.className = 'badge badge-baik text-xs';
                else els.roleBadgeHeader.className = 'badge badge-dipinjam text-xs';

                applyRoleRestrictions();
                loadPage('dashboard');
            }

            function loadPage(pageId) {
                state.activePage = pageId;
                
                // Update Nav UI
                els.navLinks.forEach(link => {
                    if (link.dataset.target === pageId) {
                        link.classList.add('bg-magenta-50', 'text-magenta-700');
                        link.classList.remove('text-gray-600', 'hover:bg-gray-50');
                        link.querySelector('i').classList.add('text-magenta-500');
                        link.querySelector('i').classList.remove('text-gray-400');
                        els.pageTitle.textContent = link.textContent.trim();
                    } else {
                        link.classList.remove('bg-magenta-50', 'text-magenta-700');
                        link.classList.add('text-gray-600', 'hover:bg-gray-50');
                        link.querySelector('i').classList.remove('text-magenta-500');
                        link.querySelector('i').classList.add('text-gray-400');
                    }
                });

                // Show Page Container
                els.pages.forEach(p => p.classList.add('hidden-safely'));
                document.getElementById('page-' + pageId).classList.remove('hidden-safely');

                // Fetch Data based on page
                if (pageId === 'dashboard') fetchDashboard();
                else if (pageId === 'inventaris') fetchInventaris();
                else if (pageId === 'peminjaman') fetchPeminjaman();
                else if (pageId === 'laporan') prepareLaporan();
            }

            // --- DASHBOARD LOGIC ---
            async function fetchDashboard() {
                showFullPageLoading(true);
                var reqPage = state.activePage;
                try {
                    var res = await gasRun('getDashboardData', state.token);
                    if (res.sessionExpired) return handleSessionExpired();
                    if (state.activePage !== reqPage) return;
                    if (res.success) {
                        renderDashboard(res.data);
                    }
                } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
                showFullPageLoading(false);
            }

            function renderDashboard(d) {
                document.getElementById('dashTotalBarang').textContent = d.total || 0;
                document.getElementById('dashKondisiBaik').textContent = d.baik || 0;
                document.getElementById('dashStokRendah').textContent = d.stok_rendah || 0;
                document.getElementById('dashPinjamAktif').textContent = d.pinjam_aktif || 0;

                var listKondisi = document.getElementById('dashKondisiList');
                listKondisi.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="flex justify-between items-center"><span class="text-gray-600"><i class="fas fa-check-circle text-emerald-500 mr-2"></i>Baik</span><span class="font-semibold">${d.baik||0}</span></div>
                    <div class="flex justify-between items-center"><span class="text-gray-600"><i class="fas fa-wrench text-amber-500 mr-2"></i>Rusak Ringan</span><span class="font-semibold">${d.rusak_ringan||0}</span></div>
                    <div class="flex justify-between items-center"><span class="text-gray-600"><i class="fas fa-times-circle text-red-500 mr-2"></i>Rusak Berat</span><span class="font-semibold">${d.rusak_berat||0}</span></div>
                    <div class="flex justify-between items-center"><span class="text-gray-600"><i class="fas fa-question-circle text-gray-500 mr-2"></i>Hilang</span><span class="font-semibold">${d.hilang||0}</span></div>
                `;

                var tbody = document.getElementById('dashStokRendahTable');
                tbody.innerHTML = '';
                if(d.stok_rendah_list && d.stok_rendah_list.length > 0) {
                    d.stok_rendah_list.forEach(i => {
                        tbody.innerHTML += `<tr><td>${escapeHTML(i.Kode_Inventaris)}</td><td>${escapeHTML(i.Nama_Barang)}</td><td><span class="text-red-600 font-bold">${i.Stok}</span> ${escapeHTML(i.Satuan)}</td></tr>`;
                    });
                } else {
                    tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="3" class="text-center text-gray-500">Tidak ada barang dengan stok rendah</td></tr>`;
                }
            }

            // --- INVENTARIS LOGIC ---
            async function fetchInventaris() {
                showFullPageLoading(true);
                var reqPage = state.activePage;
                try {
                    var res = await gasRun('getInventarisData', state.token);
                    if (res.sessionExpired) return handleSessionExpired();
                    if (state.activePage !== reqPage) return;
                    if (res.success) {
                        state.data.inventaris = res.inventaris || [];
                        state.data.kategori = res.kategori || [];
                        state.data.lokasi = res.lokasi || [];
                        populateSelectsInv();
                        renderTableInv();
                    }
                } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
                showFullPageLoading(false);
            }

            function populateSelectsInv() {
                var selKat = document.getElementById('filterKategoriInv');
                var selInvKat = document.getElementById('invKategori');
                var selInvLok = document.getElementById('invLokasi');
                
                selKat.innerHTML = '<option value="">Semua Kategori</option>';
                selInvKat.innerHTML = '';
                selInvLok.innerHTML = '';

                state.data.kategori.forEach(k => {
                    selKat.innerHTML += `<option value="${escapeHTML(k.Nama_Kategori)}">${escapeHTML(k.Nama_Kategori)}</option>`;
                    selInvKat.innerHTML += `<option value="${escapeHTML(k.Nama_Kategori)}">${escapeHTML(k.Nama_Kategori)}</option>`;
                });
                state.data.lokasi.forEach(l => {
                    selInvLok.innerHTML += `<option value="${escapeHTML(l.Nama_Lokasi)}">${escapeHTML(l.Nama_Lokasi)}</option>`;
                });
            }

            function renderTableInv() {
                var tbody = document.getElementById('tableInvBody');
                tbody.innerHTML = '';
                var search = document.getElementById('searchInv').value.toLowerCase();
                var filterKat = document.getElementById('filterKategoriInv').value;

                var filtered = state.data.inventaris.filter(i => {
                    var matchSearch = (i.Nama_Barang||'').toLowerCase().includes(search) || (i.Kode_Inventaris||'').toLowerCase().includes(search);
                    var matchKat = filterKat ? i.Kategori === filterKat : true;
                    return matchSearch && matchKat;
                });

                if(filtered.length === 0) {
                    tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="8" class="text-center text-gray-500 py-4">Data tidak ditemukan</td></tr>`;
                    return;
                }

                filtered.forEach(i => {
                    var badgeClass = 'badge-hilang';
                    if(i.Kondisi === 'Baik') badgeClass = 'badge-baik';
                    else if(i.Kondisi === 'Rusak Ringan') badgeClass = 'badge-rusak-ringan';
                    else if(i.Kondisi === 'Rusak Berat') badgeClass = 'badge-rusak-berat';

                    var stokHtml = `<span class="${i.Stok <= i.Stok_Minimum ? 'text-red-600 font-bold' : ''}">${i.Stok} ${escapeHTML(i.Satuan)}</span>`;

                    var actions = state.user.role === 'Admin' ? `
                        <button onclick="editInv('${i.ID_Inventaris}')" class="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-900 mr-2" title="Edit"><i class="fas fa-edit"></i></button>
                        <button onclick="deleteInv('${i.ID_Inventaris}')" class="text-red-600 hover:text-red-900" title="Hapus"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i></button>
                    ` : `<span class="text-gray-400 text-xs">Read-only</span>`;

                    tbody.innerHTML += `
                        <tr>
                            <td class="font-medium">${escapeHTML(i.Kode_Inventaris)}</td>
                            <td>${escapeHTML(i.Nama_Barang)}</td>
                            <td>${escapeHTML(i.Jenis)}</td>
                            <td>${escapeHTML(i.Kategori)}</td>
                            <td>${stokHtml}</td>
                            <td><span class="badge ${badgeClass}">${escapeHTML(i.Kondisi)}</span></td>
                            <td>${escapeHTML(i.Lokasi)}</td>
                            <td class="text-right role-admin-only">${actions}</td>
                        </tr>
                    `;
                });
                applyRoleRestrictions();
            }

            window.editInv = function(id) {
                var item = state.data.inventaris.find(i => i.ID_Inventaris === id);
                if(!item) return;
                document.getElementById('modalInvTitle').textContent = 'Edit Barang';
                document.getElementById('invId').value = item.ID_Inventaris;
                document.getElementById('invKode').value = item.Kode_Inventaris;
                document.getElementById('invNama').value = item.Nama_Barang;
                document.getElementById('invJenis').value = item.Jenis;
                document.getElementById('invKategori').value = item.Kategori;
                document.getElementById('invSatuan').value = item.Satuan;
                document.getElementById('invStok').value = item.Stok;
                document.getElementById('invStokMin').value = item.Stok_Minimum;
                document.getElementById('invKondisi').value = item.Kondisi;
                document.getElementById('invLokasi').value = item.Lokasi;
                document.getElementById('invTahun').value = item.Tahun_Perolehan || '';
                document.getElementById('invKeterangan').value = item.Keterangan || '';
                
                document.getElementById('modalInv').classList.remove('hidden-safely');
            };

            window.deleteInv = async function(id) {
                if(!confirm('Yakin ingin menghapus data ini?')) return;
                var backup = [...state.data.inventaris];
                state.data.inventaris = state.data.inventaris.filter(i => i.ID_Inventaris !== id);
                renderTableInv(); // Optimistic

                try {
                    var res = await gasRun('deleteInventaris', state.token, id);
                    if(res.sessionExpired) return handleSessionExpired();
                    if(res.success) showToast('Data dihapus', 'success');
                    else throw new Error(res.message);
                } catch(e) {
                    state.data.inventaris = backup;
                    renderTableInv();
                    showToast('Gagal menghapus: ' + e.message, 'error');
                }
            };

            async function handleSaveInv() {
                var item = {
                    ID_Inventaris: document.getElementById('invId').value,
                    Kode_Inventaris: document.getElementById('invKode').value,
                    Nama_Barang: document.getElementById('invNama').value,
                    Jenis: document.getElementById('invJenis').value,
                    Kategori: document.getElementById('invKategori').value,
                    Satuan: document.getElementById('invSatuan').value,
                    Stok: parseInt(document.getElementById('invStok').value) || 0,
                    Stok_Minimum: parseInt(document.getElementById('invStokMin').value) || 0,
                    Kondisi: document.getElementById('invKondisi').value,
                    Lokasi: document.getElementById('invLokasi').value,
                    Tahun_Perolehan: document.getElementById('invTahun').value,
                    Keterangan: document.getElementById('invKeterangan').value
                };

                document.getElementById('modalInv').classList.add('hidden-safely');
                showFullPageLoading(true, 'Menyimpan...');

                try {
                    var res = await gasRun('saveInventaris', state.token, item);
                    if(res.sessionExpired) return handleSessionExpired();
                    if(res.success) {
                        showToast('Data berhasil disimpan', 'success');
                        fetchInventaris(); // Reload to get new ID/Kode
                    } else {
                        showToast('Gagal: ' + res.message, 'error');
                    }
                } catch(e) {
                    showToast('Error koneksi', 'error');
                } finally {
                    showFullPageLoading(false);
                }
            }

            // --- PEMINJAMAN LOGIC ---
            async function fetchPeminjaman() {
                showFullPageLoading(true);
                var reqPage = state.activePage;
                try {
                    var res = await gasRun('getPeminjamanData', state.token);
                    if (res.sessionExpired) return handleSessionExpired();
                    if (state.activePage !== reqPage) return;
                    if (res.success) {
                        state.data.peminjaman = res.peminjaman || [];
                        if(res.inventaris) state.data.inventaris = res.inventaris; // update stock
                        renderTablePinjam();
                    }
                } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
                showFullPageLoading(false);
            }

            function renderTablePinjam() {
                var tbody = document.getElementById('tablePinjamBody');
                tbody.innerHTML = '';
                var filterStat = document.getElementById('filterStatusPinjam').value;

                var filtered = state.data.peminjaman.filter(p => filterStat ? p.Status === filterStat : true);

                if(filtered.length === 0) {
                    tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="6" class="text-center text-gray-500 py-4">Tidak ada transaksi</td></tr>`;
                    return;
                }

                filtered.sort((a,b) => new Date(b.Tanggal_Pinjam) - new Date(a.Tanggal_Pinjam)).forEach(p => {
                    var badgeClass = 'badge-dipinjam';
                    if(p.Status === 'Selesai') badgeClass = 'badge-selesai';
                    else if(p.Status === 'Sebagian Kembali') badgeClass = 'badge-sebagian';
                    else if(p.Status === 'Terlambat') badgeClass = 'badge-terlambat';

                    var actions = '';
                    if(state.user.role === 'Admin') {
                        if(p.Status !== 'Selesai') {
                            actions = `<button onclick="prosesKembali('${p.ID_Peminjaman}')" class="text-emerald-600 hover:text-emerald-900 bg-emerald-100 px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-medium">Proses Kembali</button>`;
                        } else {
                            actions = `<button onclick="lihatDetailPinjam('${p.ID_Peminjaman}')" class="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-900 bg-blue-100 px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-medium">Detail</button>`;
                        }
                    } else {
                        actions = `<button onclick="lihatDetailPinjam('${p.ID_Peminjaman}')" class="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-900 bg-blue-100 px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-medium">Lihat</button>`;
                    }

                    tbody.innerHTML += `
                        <tr>
                            <td class="font-medium text-xs">${escapeHTML(p.ID_Peminjaman)}</td>
                            <td>${escapeHTML(p.Nama_Peminjam)}</td>
                            <td>${safeDate(p.Tanggal_Pinjam)}</td>
                            <td>${safeDate(p.Tanggal_Rencana_Kembali)}</td>
                            <td><span class="badge ${badgeClass}">${escapeHTML(p.Status)}</span></td>
                            <td class="text-right">${actions}</td>
                        </tr>
                    `;
                });
            }

            // Form Peminjaman Items
            var pinjamItems = [];
            
            function renderPinjamItems() {
                var tbody = document.getElementById('pinjamItemsBody');
                tbody.innerHTML = '';
                var options = state.data.inventaris.filter(i => i.Stok > 0).map(i => `<option value="${i.ID_Inventaris}">${i.Kode_Inventaris} - ${i.Nama_Barang} (Sisa: ${i.Stok} ${i.Satuan})</option>`).join('');
                
                pinjamItems.forEach((item, idx) => {
                    var tr = document.createElement('tr');
                    var invData = state.data.inventaris.find(x => x.ID_Inventaris === item.ID_Inventaris);
                    var maxStok = invData ? invData.Stok : 0;
                    
                    tr.innerHTML = `
                        <td>
                            <select class="item-select w-full border-gray-300 rounded text-sm px-2 py-1" data-idx="${idx}">
                                <option value="">Pilih Barang...</option>
                                ${options}
                            </select>
                        </td>
                        <td class="text-center">${maxStok}</td>
                        <td><input type="number" class="item-qty w-full border-gray-300 rounded text-sm px-2 py-1 text-center" value="${item.qty}" min="1" max="${maxStok}" data-idx="${idx}"></td>
                        <td class="text-right"><button type="button" class="text-red-500 hover:text-red-700" onclick="removePinjamItem(${idx})"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i></button></td>
                    `;
                    tbody.appendChild(tr);
                    if(item.ID_Inventaris) {
                        tr.querySelector('.item-select').value = item.ID_Inventaris;
                    }
                });

                // Attach events
                document.querySelectorAll('.item-select').forEach(el => el.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
                    var idx = e.target.dataset.idx;
                    pinjamItems[idx].ID_Inventaris = e.target.value;
                    renderPinjamItems(); // re-render to update max stock display
                }));
                document.querySelectorAll('.item-qty').forEach(el => el.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
                    var idx = e.target.dataset.idx;
                    pinjamItems[idx].qty = parseInt(e.target.value) || 1;
                }));
            }

            window.removePinjamItem = function(idx) {
                pinjamItems.splice(idx, 1);
                renderPinjamItems();
            }

            async function handleSaveTransaksi() {
                var header = {
                    Nama_Peminjam: document.getElementById('pinjamNama').value,
                    Keperluan: document.getElementById('pinjamKeperluan').value,
                    Tanggal_Pinjam: document.getElementById('pinjamTglPinjam').value,
                    Tanggal_Rencana_Kembali: document.getElementById('pinjamTglKembali').value
                };

                var validItems = pinjamItems.filter(i => i.ID_Inventaris && i.qty > 0);
                if(validItems.length === 0) {
                    showToast('Pilih minimal 1 barang', 'error'); return;
                }

                document.getElementById('modalPinjam').classList.add('hidden-safely');
                showFullPageLoading(true, 'Memproses transaksi...');

                try {
                    var res = await gasRun('savePeminjaman', state.token, header, validItems);
                    if(res.sessionExpired) return handleSessionExpired();
                    if(res.success) {
                        showToast('Transaksi berhasil dibuat', 'success');
                        fetchPeminjaman(); // Refresh data
                    } else {
                        showToast('Gagal: ' + res.message, 'error');
                    }
                } catch(e) {
                    showToast('Error koneksi', 'error');
                } finally {
                    showFullPageLoading(false);
                }
            }

            // Pengembalian
            var activeKembaliId = null;
            window.prosesKembali = function(id) {
                var p = state.data.peminjaman.find(x => x.ID_Peminjaman === id);
                if(!p || !p.details) return;
                activeKembaliId = id;
                
                var html = `
                    <div class="mb-4 bg-blue-50 p-3 rounded text-sm">
                        <p><strong>Peminjam:</strong> ${escapeHTML(p.Nama_Peminjam)}</p>
                        <p><strong>Tgl Pinjam:</strong> ${safeDate(p.Tanggal_Pinjam)}</p>
                    </div>
                    <table class="w-full text-sm">
                        <thead><tr class="bg-gray-100"><th class="text-left p-2">Barang</th><th class="p-2 text-center">Pinjam</th><th class="p-2 text-center">Sudah Kembali</th><th class="p-2 text-center">Kembali Skrg</th><th class="p-2">Kondisi</th></tr></thead>
                        <tbody>
                `;

                p.details.forEach((d, idx) => {
                    var inv = state.data.inventaris.find(i => i.ID_Inventaris === d.ID_Inventaris);
                    var nama = inv ? inv.Nama_Barang : d.ID_Inventaris;
                    var sisa = d.Jumlah_Pinjam - d.Jumlah_Kembali;
                    if(sisa > 0) {
                        html += `
                            <tr class="border-b" data-detail-id="${d.ID_Detail || d.ID_Inventaris}">
                                <td class="p-2">${escapeHTML(nama)}</td>
                                <td class="p-2 text-center">${d.Jumlah_Pinjam}</td>
                                <td class="p-2 text-center">${d.Jumlah_Kembali}</td>
                                <td class="p-2 text-center"><input type="number" class="kembali-qty w-16 border rounded text-center" value="${sisa}" min="0" max="${sisa}" data-id="${d.ID_Inventaris}"></td>
                                <td class="p-2">
                                    <select class="kembali-kondisi border rounded px-1 py-1 w-full" data-id="${d.ID_Inventaris}">
                                        <option value="Baik">Baik</option>
                                        <option value="Rusak Ringan">Rusak Ringan</option>
                                        <option value="Rusak Berat">Rusak Berat</option>
                                        <option value="Hilang">Hilang</option>
                                    </select>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        `;
                    }
                });

                html += `</tbody></table>`;
                document.getElementById('kembaliContent').innerHTML = html;
                document.getElementById('btnProsesKembali').classList.remove('hidden-safely');
                document.getElementById('modalKembali').classList.remove('hidden-safely');
            };

            window.lihatDetailPinjam = function(id) {
                // Similar to prosesKembali but read-only UI
                var p = state.data.peminjaman.find(x => x.ID_Peminjaman === id);
                if(!p || !p.details) return;
                
                var html = `
                    <div class="mb-4 bg-gray-50 p-3 rounded text-sm border">
                        <p><strong>Peminjam:</strong> ${escapeHTML(p.Nama_Peminjam)}</p>
                        <p><strong>Status:</strong> ${escapeHTML(p.Status)}</p>
                    </div>
                    <table class="w-full text-sm">
                        <thead><tr class="bg-gray-100"><th class="text-left p-2">Barang</th><th class="p-2 text-center">Pinjam</th><th class="p-2 text-center">Dikembalikan</th></tr></thead>
                        <tbody>
                `;
                p.details.forEach(d => {
                     var inv = state.data.inventaris.find(i => i.ID_Inventaris === d.ID_Inventaris);
                     var nama = inv ? inv.Nama_Barang : d.ID_Inventaris;
                     html += `<tr class="border-b"><td class="p-2">${escapeHTML(nama)}</td><td class="p-2 text-center">${d.Jumlah_Pinjam}</td><td class="p-2 text-center">${d.Jumlah_Kembali}</td></tr>`;
                });
                html += `</tbody></table>`;
                document.getElementById('kembaliContent').innerHTML = html;
                document.getElementById('btnProsesKembali').classList.add('hidden-safely');
                document.getElementById('modalKembali').classList.remove('hidden-safely');
            }

            async function handleProsesKembali() {
                var returns = [];
                document.querySelectorAll('#kembaliContent tbody tr').forEach(tr => {
                    var idInv = tr.querySelector('.kembali-qty').dataset.id;
                    var qty = parseInt(tr.querySelector('.kembali-qty').value) || 0;
                    var kondisi = tr.querySelector('.kembali-kondisi').value;
                    if(qty > 0) {
                        returns.push({ ID_Inventaris: idInv, qty: qty, kondisi: kondisi });
                    }
                });

                if(returns.length === 0) {
                    showToast('Tidak ada barang yang dikembalikan', 'info'); return;
                }

                document.getElementById('modalKembali').classList.add('hidden-safely');
                showFullPageLoading(true, 'Memproses pengembalian...');

                try {
                    var res = await gasRun('prosesPengembalian', state.token, activeKembaliId, returns);
                    if(res.sessionExpired) return handleSessionExpired();
                    if(res.success) {
                        showToast('Pengembalian berhasil dicatat', 'success');
                        fetchPeminjaman();
                    } else {
                        showToast('Gagal: ' + res.message, 'error');
                    }
                } catch(e) {
                    showToast('Error koneksi', 'error');
                } finally {
                    showFullPageLoading(false);
                }
            }

            // --- LAPORAN LOGIC ---
            function prepareLaporan() {
                // Populate filters
                var selKat = document.getElementById('lapKategori');
                selKat.innerHTML = '<option value="">Semua Kategori</option>';
                state.data.kategori.forEach(k => selKat.innerHTML += `<option value="${escapeHTML(k.Nama_Kategori)}">${escapeHTML(k.Nama_Kategori)}</option>`);
                document.getElementById('lapContainer').classList.add('hidden-safely');
            }

            document.getElementById('lapJenis').addEventListener('change', function(e) {
                var j = e.target.value;
                if(j === 'peminjaman') {
                    document.querySelectorAll('.filter-group-inv').forEach(el => el.classList.add('hidden-safely'));
                    document.querySelector('.filter-group-pinjam').classList.remove('hidden-safely');
                } else {
                    document.querySelectorAll('.filter-group-inv').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('hidden-safely'));
                    document.querySelector('.filter-group-pinjam').classList.add('hidden-safely');
                }
            });

            async function generateLaporan() {
                var jenis = document.getElementById('lapJenis').value;
                showFullPageLoading(true, 'Menyiapkan laporan...');
                try {
                    var res = await gasRun('getReportData', state.token, jenis);
                    if(res.sessionExpired) return handleSessionExpired();
                    if(res.success) {
                        renderLaporanTable(jenis, res.data);
                    }
                } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
                showFullPageLoading(false);
            }

            function renderLaporanTable(jenis, data) {
                var thead = document.getElementById('lapThead');
                var tbody = document.getElementById('lapTbody');
                thead.innerHTML = ''; tbody.innerHTML = '';
                
                var filtered = [];

                if(jenis === 'inventaris' || jenis === 'stok_rendah') {
                    var fKat = document.getElementById('lapKategori').value;
                    var fKon = document.getElementById('lapKondisi').value;
                    
                    filtered = data.filter(i => {
                        var mKat = fKat ? i.Kategori === fKat : true;
                        var mKon = fKon ? i.Kondisi === fKon : true;
                        var mStok = jenis === 'stok_rendah' ? i.Stok <= i.Stok_Minimum : true;
                        return mKat && mKon && mStok;
                    });

                    thead.innerHTML = `<tr><th>Kode</th><th>Nama Barang</th><th>Kategori</th><th>Stok</th><th>Kondisi</th><th>Lokasi</th></tr>`;
                    filtered.forEach(i => {
                        tbody.innerHTML += `<tr><td>${escapeHTML(i.Kode_Inventaris)}</td><td>${escapeHTML(i.Nama_Barang)}</td><td>${escapeHTML(i.Kategori)}</td><td>${i.Stok} ${escapeHTML(i.Satuan)}</td><td>${escapeHTML(i.Kondisi)}</td><td>${escapeHTML(i.Lokasi)}</td></tr>`;
                    });
                } else if(jenis === 'peminjaman') {
                    var fStat = document.getElementById('lapStatusPinjam').value;
                    filtered = data.filter(p => fStat ? p.Status === fStat : true);

                    thead.innerHTML = `<tr><th>ID Trx</th><th>Peminjam</th><th>Tgl Pinjam</th><th>Batas Kembali</th><th>Status</th></tr>`;
                    filtered.forEach(p => {
                        tbody.innerHTML += `<tr><td>${escapeHTML(p.ID_Peminjaman)}</td><td>${escapeHTML(p.Nama_Peminjam)}</td><td>${safeDate(p.Tanggal_Pinjam)}</td><td>${safeDate(p.Tanggal_Rencana_Kembali)}</td><td>${escapeHTML(p.Status)}</td></tr>`;
                    });
                }

                if(filtered.length === 0) tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="6" class="text-center py-4">Data kosong</td></tr>`;
                document.getElementById('lapContainer').classList.remove('hidden-safely');
            }

            // --- EXPORT LOGIC ---
            function exportXLSX() {
                var table = document.getElementById('lapTable');
                if(!table || table.rows.length <= 1) return showToast('Tidak ada data untuk diekspor', 'error');
                var wb = XLSX.utils.table_to_book(table, {sheet: "Laporan"});
                XLSX.writeFile(wb, 'Laporan_Lab_' + new Date().getTime() + '.xlsx');
            }

            function exportPDF() {
                var table = document.getElementById('lapTable');
                if(!table || table.rows.length <= 1) return showToast('Tidak ada data untuk diekspor', 'error');
                
                const { jsPDF } = window.jspdf;
                const doc = new jsPDF();
                
                var title = "Laporan Laboratorium IPA";
                var jenis = document.getElementById('lapJenis').options[document.getElementById('lapJenis').selectedIndex].text;
                
                doc.setFontSize(16);
                doc.text(title, 14, 15);
                doc.setFontSize(11);
                doc.text("Jenis: " + jenis, 14, 22);
                doc.text("Dicetak pada: " + new Date().toLocaleString('id-ID'), 14, 28);

                doc.autoTable({
                    html: '#lapTable',
                    startY: 35,
                    theme: 'grid',
                    headStyles: { fillColor: [190, 24, 93] } // Magenta 700
                });
                
                doc.save('Laporan_Lab_' + new Date().getTime() + '.pdf');
            }

            // --- EVENT LISTENERS ---
            function setupEventListeners() {
                document.getElementById('loginForm').addEventListener('submit', handleLogin);
                els.btnLogout.addEventListener('click', handleLogout);
                
                els.navLinks.forEach(link => {
                    link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        loadPage(this.dataset.target);
                        if(window.innerWidth < 768) els.navLinks[0].parentNode.parentNode.classList.add('hidden');
                    });
                });

                document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
                    var sidebar = document.querySelector('aside.w-64');
                    sidebar.classList.toggle('hidden');
                    sidebar.classList.toggle('absolute');
                    sidebar.classList.toggle('z-40');
                    sidebar.classList.toggle('h-full');
                });

                // Modal Closers
                document.querySelectorAll('.close-modal').forEach(btn => {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                        this.closest('.fixed').classList.add('hidden-safely');
                    });
                });

                // Inventaris Listeners
                document.getElementById('searchInv').addEventListener('input', renderTableInv);
                document.getElementById('filterKategoriInv').addEventListener('change', renderTableInv);
                document.getElementById('btnTambahInv').addEventListener('click', function() {
                    document.getElementById('formInv').reset();
                    document.getElementById('invId').value = '';
                    document.getElementById('modalInvTitle').textContent = 'Tambah Barang';
                    document.getElementById('modalInv').classList.remove('hidden-safely');
                });
                document.getElementById('formInv').addEventListener('submit', handleSaveInv);

                // Peminjaman Listeners
                document.getElementById('filterStatusPinjam').addEventListener('change', renderTablePinjam);
                document.getElementById('btnTambahPinjam').addEventListener('click', function() {
                    document.getElementById('formPinjam').reset();
                    pinjamItems = [];
                    renderPinjamItems();
                    document.getElementById('modalPinjam').classList.remove('hidden-safely');
                });
                document.getElementById('btnAddItemPinjam').addEventListener('click', function() {
                    pinjamItems.push({ID_Inventaris: '', qty: 1});
                    renderPinjamItems();
                });
                document.getElementById('btnSavePinjam').addEventListener('click', handleSaveTransaksi);
                document.getElementById('btnProsesKembali').addEventListener('click', handleProsesKembali);

                // Laporan Listeners
                document.getElementById('btnGenerateLap').addEventListener('click', generateLaporan);
                document.getElementById('btnExportXLSX').addEventListener('click', exportXLSX);
                document.getElementById('btnExportPDF').addEventListener('click', exportPDF);
            }

        })();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
